description:
Extends toolranks support.

This minetest mod adds [toolranks](https://content.luanti.org/packages/lisacvuk/toolranks/) support for `minetest-games`’s mods (except `default`).
This mod currently adds support for hoes from `farming` mod.
This mod is compatible with [farming redo](https://content.luanti.org/packages/TenPlus1/farming/) (nothing breaks if you have both installed).
This mod also adds an API to register new types of tools for toolranks.
